name: THE BED SHOP
note: Live Kuwaiti retailer, 10+ branches since 1995 (Tempur, Sealy, King Koil), but its anchor identity is beds and mattresses, a narrow long-replacement-cycle line the rulebook lists as a Gate 3 fail; the bedding/pillow accessories do not change the low-frequency core.

name: Toot Company
note: toot-t.com is a diversified Taif holding company (self-described leading construction/contracting firm, plus hospitality and a retail-trade arm) with no consumer e-commerce cart. Construction-led mixed conglomerate (Gate 6) with no dedicated storefront (Gate 4).

name: Thabt
note: Not an auto dealer as tagged: it is a Qatar-HQ'd consumer e-commerce store selling device holders and mounts (phone, tablet, GPS, dashcam, motorcycle; QAR 30 to 390). Still fails Gate 3 as a narrow, low-repeat single product line at small SME scale.

name: دهانات تايم - Timepaints
note: Saudi paint and coatings manufacturer-retailer since 1987 (interior/exterior paints, wood stains, thermal insulation, 4,500 colors). Paints are construction/building materials (Gate 2) and a narrow low-repeat line; correctly excluded despite a live online store.

name: Ubuy Inc
note: The 'automotive' tag is a wrong keyword match. Ubuy is a Kuwait-City-HQ'd (founded 2012) cross-border e-commerce platform with 100M+ products and a 1M+ download app, qualifying outright via the Gate 5b app-download path; general merchandise, Kuwait HQ confirmed.

name: TOYOTA KUWAIT - MOHAMED NASER ALSAYER & SONS EST.CO.W.L.L
note: Mohamed Naser Alsayer & Sons, the Toyota distributor/dealer for Kuwait. Automotive dealership is a Gate 2 hard exclusion, with no separate consumer-retail arm on this entity.

name: United Motors Company
note: The 'building_materials' tag was wrong, but it is still excluded: a Saudi automotive group (Kia and Jetour dealer, auto-parts distribution via anycarpart.com, collision/repair, 1,100+ staff). Automotive is a Gate 2 hard exclusion with no non-auto retail arm.

name: وكف | wacafe
note: Live Saudi coffee brand (packaged coffee harvests plus branded mugs/home goods, SAR checkout, loyalty). Category (F&B) is fine, but the catalog is roughly 25 SKUs, below the ~50 Gate 5a floor, with no 50k+ app to rescue it.

name: United Group
note: Saudi B2B food group: United Trading Corp (food import/distribution), United Food Services (McDonald's distribution centre), United Warehousing (3PL logistics), and Lactalis cheese manufacturing. Pure B2B distribution/logistics/manufacturing, no consumer retail arm (Gate 2).

name: weftrug
note: Rugs and carpets retailer plus carpet installation. 'Flooring/carpet only' is an explicit Gate 3 narrow low-repeat fail.

name: werecle
note: The 'wholesale_distribution' tag is wrong. werecle.com is CLE, a self-described homegrown Saudi (Riyadh) luxury retailer for watches, fine jewelry and accessories (30+ official brands) with a live online store and a physical gallery at Via Riyadh. Approved jewelry/luxury category, Saudi HQ.

name: Wahag Medical Company
note: The 'building_materials' tag is wrong. Wahag is a Saudi cosmetics/health distributor (B2B) that also runs dedicated consumer beauty stores: ucarestore.com (You Care) is a live SAR storefront (skincare, haircare, makeup; La Roche-Posay, Vichy, Catrice) plus a Salla store. Hybrid B2B/B2C where the retail arm qualifies on its own merits (approved beauty/personal-care, Saudi HQ).

name: JETOUR QATAR
note: Qatar dealer for Jetour, a Chinese automotive brand. Automotive dealership is a Gate 2 hard exclusion.

name: HALA AUTO
note: Saudi (Riyadh) Toyota and Lexus authorized dealer and service center under Abdul Latif Jameel, established 2013 (vehicle sales plus maintenance). Automotive is a Gate 2 hard exclusion.

name: Naser Al Sayer Group
note: Kuwaiti mixed conglomerate: consumer-electronics and furniture retail alongside construction/concrete/asphalt, logistics, real estate and contracting. Per Gate 6 the mixed parent is excluded (a retail subsidiary would need its own row); this is a holding-company site with no single storefront.

name: Syarah
note: Saudi (Riyadh) used-car marketplace with iOS/Android apps. Automotive is a Gate 2 hard exclusion and a big-ticket, low-repeat purchase; the Gate 5b app-rescue path targets high-frequency digital services (delivery/voucher/grocery), not vehicle sales, so it does not rescue this.

name: Adsela Marketing Solutions
note: Riyadh digital marketing agency (SEO, web design and development, paid ads, social, app development). B2B service provider, not a product retailer (Gate 2 b2b_services).

name: Food Gate
note: Food-service B2B equipment supply (kitchen smallware, refrigeration/storage-transport), distinct from the F&B dining company foodsgate.sa. B2B food-service supply is a Gate 2 exclusion.

name: Saudi Jawahir
note: Genuinely a premier Riyadh luxury retailer (jewelry/fashion/beauty; the Avanti and PIU multi-brand stores; De Beers, Tom Ford), approved category and Saudi HQ. But the live transactional channel is unconfirmed: the apex returns a Cloudflare error and www.jawahir.sa reads as a corporate/brand site; fetches were rate-limited/403 so no online cart could be verified (Gate 4 ambiguous).

name: مكتبة الجزيرة
note: Real Mecca bookstore (books are approved, Saudi HQ), search-indexed as a live electronic store for Arabic and translated books, but jazeara.com returns a persistent 403 bot-block and the prior storefront subdomain (book.jazeara.com) was reported dead, so the live cart is unconfirmable either way (Gate 4).

name: Kitchen Zone مطابخ زون
note: A Riyadh kitchen-cabinetry designer, manufacturer and installer (European-spec kitchens and cabinets, delivery/installation model), operating via social pages with no transactional cart. Kitchen/cabinetry via project/installation plus manufacturing is a Gate 2 exclusion.

name: ليوان | Liwan
note: Liwan Real Estate Development, a Riyadh mixed-use real-estate developer (residential/commercial/tourism projects such as Liwan Najd). Real estate is a Gate 2 exclusion; the 'Experience Lounge' is a sales gallery, not retail.

name: MarTech Tree
note: Jeddah marketing-and-technology agency (B2B services), not a retailer (Gate 2 b2b_services).

name: mochaboutique
note: No verifiable live Saudi retailer at this domain; search found only an unrelated US lingerie brand on a different domain (mochaboutique.store), and no known Saudi 'Mocha Boutique' e-commerce brand exists. Per Gate 7, unconfirmable/no live site defaults OUT.
